description: Fetch the EIP-5564 / EIP-6538 stealth meta-address registered by an address for a given scheme ID (typically schemeId=1 for the SECP256k1 scheme). Returns the raw bytes and a hasMetaAddress boolean. Lets agents check if a recipient supports stealth-address payments before constructing one.

registrant.description: Address whose stealth meta-address you want.

scheme_id.description: Stealth address scheme ID (default 1 = SECP256k1 per EIP-5564).

name: thryx_stealth_meta_address
